method: Every package SHA-256 checked against signed repository index; embedded recipe_digest matched to preserved normalized recipe. Original sources traced through exact package records/build keys/parent hashes; every upstream input file SHA-256 verified locally.
limits: Historical build-record verification, not upstream author signature verification.
Installer bootstrap runtime contains host-provided binaries; this is not a complete per-component SBOM.
